description: Replace the integrated solver's 52.2 ms n=512 one-CTA serial tail after the eight-column cluster prefix with a blocked tensor-core dense-to-band reduction and parallel bulge chase: reuse cluster-produced reflectors, form compact-WY panels in FP32, retain the 25-step solve, structure gate, exact certificate, adaptive repair, and all other size paths.

Exposed the existing 2x768 eight-column n512 cluster prefix as a standalone stage, reconstructed its exact similarity-transformed matrix, continued with six 64-column FP32 compact-WY panels through tensor-core high-precision GEMMs, solved the banded matrix with BF16x9 Xsyev, and reversed both panel and prefix reflectors before the unchanged certificate and repair. Build and all 39 official tests pass. Full metric regresses from parent 37581.232 to 45618.080 us: dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 are 201331/224564/441181 us, while structure-gated rankdef/clustered remain 152681/122999 us, measuring the library finish and repair cost on this blocked base.

Replaced the n512 one-CTA serial tail after the selected eight-column cluster prefix with 502 globally synchronized column stages: a 256-thread Householder-preparation CTA per matrix, four 256-thread CTAs per matrix for symmetric matvec and partial correction, and four CTAs for the packed rank-2 update, while retaining the parent 25-step solve, blocked backtransform, structure gate, exact certificate, and adaptive repair. Build and all 39 official tests pass. Full metric is 39466.300 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 are 146964/173510/119976 us versus parent about 118373/150950/91873, while rankdef/clustered remain library-routed at 152563/122832 us.

Replaced the 502 three-launch global tail stages with one long-lived 2x768 SM100 cluster that performs all 510 Householder columns using CTA-local v/y replicas and three cluster barriers per column, then runs the unchanged 25-step solve, blocked backtransform, structure gate, certificate, and repair. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric improves from global-tail trial 39466.300 to 38651.657 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 improve from 146964/173510/119976 to 134711/159500/108175 us, while rankdef/clustered remain 152665/122938 us. It remains above the parent, measuring the cost of per-column cluster synchronization despite shared reuse.

Attempted an exact two-stage n512 factorization that retained the eight-column clustered prefix, factored only its 504x504 trailing block with 16 concurrent cuSOLVER sytrd streams, spliced the prefix and tail tridiagonals, reused the 25-step solve, and reversed both reflector sets. The extension built, but the official validation wrapper rejected submission.py before execution because explicit CUDA stream creation/use is a leaderboard-banned construct; no correctness or performance metric was produced.

Retried the exact prefix-plus-tail construction without banned explicit execution contexts: the 2x768 cluster reduces eight columns, a cached single cuSOLVER sytrd handle factors each 504x504 trailing block, the code splices prefix and tail tridiagonals into the existing 25-step solve, then reverses tail compact-WY and prefix reflectors before certification. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric regresses to 75990.470 us because per-matrix sytrd calls serialize: dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 are 2787505/1974951/2759290 us, while structure-gated rankdef/clustered remain 152647/122990 us.

Implemented an exact device-batched blocked n512 tridiagonal reduction after the eight-column cluster prefix: each 1024-thread CTA forms 16 dependent Householders and their W vectors while analytically applying prior panel updates, then two batched FP32 high-precision GEMMs apply V*W^T+W*V^T to the residual matrix; the existing 25-step solve, reverse compact-WY transforms, gate, certificate, and repair are retained. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric is 38910.270 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 are 138677/163636/112057 us, versus 134711/159500/108175 for the full two-CTA cluster and parent roughly 118373/150950/91873.

Halved the exact blocked n512 panel width from 16 to 8 to reduce prior-column overlap reductions while preserving the eight-column cluster prefix, FP32 high-precision trailing GEMMs, 25-step solve, reverse WY transforms, exact certificate, and repair. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric regresses from 38910.270 to 39220.042 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 rise from 138677/163636/112057 to 144151/167254/116915 us, so extra launches and skinnier updates dominate the reduced panel synchronization.

Restored the selected 16-column blocked n512 panels and replaced each prior V/W column's two whole-block reductions with one warp that computes both overlaps, reducing the panel to one overlap synchronization per reflector while preserving exact recurrences, prefix, tensor-core updates, solve, backtransform, certificate, and repair. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric improves from 38910.270 to 38510.147 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 improve from 138677/163636/112057 to 128893/157830/107634 us. Dense is 5.8 ms faster than the full-cluster trial, while mixed and LAPACK-even remain slower than the parent path.

Fused each blocked n512 panel's two trailing products by concatenating [V,W] and [W,V], so one K=32 batched tensor-core GEMM forms V*W^T+W*V^T and one elementwise subtraction updates the residual matrix; all prefix, panel, solve, backtransform, certificate, and repair logic is unchanged. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric improves from 38510.147 to 38103.632 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 improve from 128893/157830/107634 to 122733/153568/101759 us. Dense and mixed are within 4.4/2.7 ms of the parent, while LAPACK-even remains about 9.9 ms slower.

Changed the fused blocked n512 trailing update to in-place baddbmm with beta=1 and alpha=-1, so the tensor-core GEMM epilogue accumulates -[V,W]*[W,V]^T directly into the strided residual matrix and eliminates the residual-sized temporary plus standalone subtraction. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric improves from 38103.632 to 37866.600 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 improve from 122733/153568/101759 to 119525/151312/98438 us. Dense and mixed are within roughly 1.2/0.4 ms of the parent; the remaining aggregate gap is under 1% and concentrated in LAPACK-even.

Ran only the blocked n512 trailing baddbmm updates at strict FP32 highest precision, restoring the n352 helper unchanged, to test whether reduced candidate error lowers adaptive refinement or selective repair. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric regresses from 37866.600 to 38074.404 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 are 122507/153437/101483 versus 119525/151312/98438 with tensor high precision. The changed residual pattern does not offset the slower panel updates.

Had the n512 panel kernel emit [V,W] and [W,V] directly into fixed-width buffers to remove 64 concatenation-copy launches, restored tensor high precision, and retained in-place baddbmm updates. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric regresses from selected 37866.600 to 38222.310 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 rise from 119525/151312/98438 to 125011/155288/103943 us. The sliced fixed-width outputs retain padded batch strides that cost more in batched GEMM than the 1.4 ms contiguous concatenation copies.

Restored the exact selected blocked reducer source after the direct-buffer and strict-precision measurements: compact V/W panel outputs, contiguous [V,W]/[W,V] concatenation, tensor high trailing baddbmm updates, and highest-precision reverse WY. Build and all 39 tests pass. Repeat full metric is 37846.520 us versus the first selected sample 37866.600; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 are 119272/151250/98462 us versus 119525/151312/98438. This corroborates the selected source within noise; parent aggregate is 37581.232 us.

Changed the panel API to emit exact compact contiguous [batch, trailing_rows, 2*width] [V,W]/[W,V] operands, avoiding both padded batch strides and PyTorch concatenation before in-place baddbmm. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric is 38064.384 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 are 125414/152751/100579 versus selected-repeat 119272/151250/98462. The single-CTA panel kernel's four packed output stores cost more than writing V/W once and using parallel concatenation kernels.

Retained compact row output but emitted only one dynamic [batch,trailing_rows,width] V tensor and W tensor from the panel kernel, then used the proven parallel concatenation and in-place baddbmm path. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric is 38018.718 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 are 121707/153269/100982 versus selected-repeat 119272/151250/98462. Compact output narrows the loss relative to duplicated direct operands, but per-value dynamic remapping in the one-CTA panel still outweighs omitted leading-row stores.

Added a flat contiguous copy fast path for the 31 full-width n512 panels while retaining dynamic remapping only for the final short panel; compact V/W outputs still feed parallel concatenation and in-place tensor baddbmm. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric is 37820.445 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 improve from compact trial 121707/153269/100982 to 118922/150544/97399 us. Dense is within 0.6 ms of the parent and mixed is about 0.4 ms faster; unrelated n352/n2048 variance and a 5.5 ms LAPACK-even gap keep the aggregate sample above parent 37581.232.

Added a third unsafe-only FP32 Newton-Schulz/Rayleigh refinement before selective Xsyev fallback on the compact blocked n512 path, targeting the 12 LAPACK-even matrices seen in the profile. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric is 37798.868 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 are 118397/150587/97361 versus 118922/150544/97399 with two refinements. LAPACK-even and mixed are unchanged within noise, so the hard repair set does not measurably clear.

Reduced the exact blocked n512 panel kernel launch from 1024 to 512 threads, permitting two 66 KiB-shared-memory CTAs per B200 SM, and restored the selected two-refinement certification policy. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric improves from 37798.868 to 37458.698 us and beats the 37581.232 parent; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 improve to 113507/147864/91998 us from 118397/150587/97361. The occupancy gain is largest on dense and LAPACK-even workloads.

Raised the exact blocked n512 panel launch from the selected 512 threads to 768 threads to measure the remaining B200 block-size point. Build and all 39 tests pass. Full metric improves from 37458.698 to 37390.268 us. Dense/mixed n512 regress from 113507/147864 to 114741/149338 us, while LAPACK-even improves from 91998 to 87757 us; the changed reduction order appears to reduce repair fallback on that numerically marginal case. Aggregate also includes favorable n2048 variance, so a repeat and profile are required before final selection.

Removed 326 lines of superseded brief experiments: serial cuSolver sytrd state/API, three unused global per-column tail kernels, the full-510-column band_eigh mutation, the staged prefix-to-Xsyev path, and the serial-tail Python continuation. Restored the parent band_eigh n512 fallback and retained only the active 8-column prefix, 16-column blocked reducer, tridiagonal solver, and range backtransform. Clean rebuild, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass. Full metric is 37453.616 us versus 37390/37425 on the same active 768-thread code before cleanup and parent 37581.232; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even n512 are stable at 114926/149433/87813 us, while the aggregate sample includes a slow unrelated n2048 run.

Selected 2a710ca651d4309efa9aa02bd31231ad0f0fe86b: replaces the n512 serial post-prefix reduction with exact 16-column V/W panels, in-place tensor-core trailing baddbmm updates, the existing 18.93 ms tridiagonal solve, and reverse compact-WY backtransform. Final clean metric 37453.616 us beats parent 37581.232 (0.34%); the same active code also measured 37390.268 and 37425.267 before dead-code cleanup. Clean build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass. n512 dense/mixed/LAPACK-even are 114926/149433/87813 us. Exact-SHA dense profile: prefix 2.950 ms, panel 41.891 ms, tridiagonal solve 18.928 ms. Exact-SHA LAPACK-even profile has no sytrd4 fallback, versus 12 fallback matrices for the earlier 1024-thread panel ordering. Profiles are brief-25-trial-19-n512[-lapack-even]-2a710ca... under autocuda/profiles/2026-07-03-13-39-25. Continue from this commit: highest-value next experiment is to preserve the faster 512-thread panel (40.94 ms) while reproducing 768-thread numerical reduction order/no-fallback behavior; then attack the panel with multi-CTA/cooperative or wider-panel designs, and the 18.93 ms serial tridiagonal solve.

Replace the integrated solver's 52.2 ms n=512 one-CTA serial tail after the eight-column cluster prefix with a blocked tensor-core dense-to-band reduction and parallel bulge chase: reuse cluster-produced reflectors, form compact-WY panels in FP32, retain the 25-step solve, structure gate, exact certificate, adaptive repair, and all other size paths.

Ran 512 physical threads but explicitly partitioned each panel correction dot into the 768-thread kernels 96 eight-lane logical groups and reduced their 24 logical warp totals in the identical tree. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass; sensitive dense and LAPACK-even validation residuals match the 768-thread candidate. Full metric regresses from 37453.616 to 38049.851 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even are 124185/155917/97079 us. Exact-SHA profile shows panel time rises from 41.891 to 51.245 ms while solve remains 18.927 ms. The sequential second logical-group loop preserves numerical behavior but introduces imbalance/register overhead.

Collapsed the duplicated base/extra 768-order correction-dot paths into one non-unrolled two-wave loop that writes each wave directly to shared logical-warp totals. Register use falls from 56 to 53 per thread; build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass with the same 768-thread residuals. Full metric improves from 38049.851 to 37894.953 us, but dense/mixed/LAPACK-even remain 123569/155991/97321 us because the second wave still recomputes one third of the expensive matrix-vector rows.

Separated the expensive y=A*v computation from the 768-order correction reduction: y rows run once with balanced 64-group 512-thread mapping, then a shared-memory v*y pass produces the exact 96 logical groups and 24-warp tree. Register use drops to 44 per thread; build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass with 768-thread residuals. Full metric is 38001.208 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even are 122623/159488/95407 us. Avoiding repeated matrix-vector rows recovers part of the loss, but an extra block barrier and logical reduction on each of 502 columns remain expensive.

Restored the balanced one-pass 512-thread y=A*v mapping and promoted only the Householder correction scalar v^T*y products and two-level reduction to FP64. The kernel uses 50 registers and retains two-CTA residency. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass. Full metric improves from the exact-order emulations to 37431.634 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even are 115738/150782/88944 us. Exact-SHA profiles show panel 43.063 ms, solve 18.928 ms, prefix 2.927 ms; LAPACK-even has zero sytrd4 fallback. FP64 buys repair-free behavior at about 2.1 ms panel cost versus the fast 512-thread FP32 reduction.

Replaced FP64 correction accumulation with Kahan-style compensated FP32 inside each 512-thread dot group, retaining the original two-level float reduction. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass; changed residuals and LAPACK-even timing indicate the repair-free numerical basin is retained. Full metric regresses to 37965.221 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even are 121666/159552/95069 us. The serial compensation dependency chain is substantially more expensive than the FP64 reduction despite reducing registers from 50 to 48.

Replaced serial compensated FP32 with two alternating FMA accumulators per 512-thread dot group, then combined them before the original block reduction. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass; residuals change and LAPACK-even timing remains in the no-fallback regime. Full metric is 37975.660 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even are 122234/159324/95167 us. Required exact-SHA profile shows the panel at 49.784 ms and solve at 18.927 ms, so the branch/two-accumulator control path remains much slower than both plain FP32 and FP64.

Kept one plain FP32 local accumulator and per-warp reduction, then promoted only the 16 warp totals and final correction multiply to FP64. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass, but benchmark-scale repair behavior worsens: full metric 38159.091 us and dense/mixed/LAPACK-even 121895/159991/100581 us. Exact-SHA profile shows panel 49.362 ms and a dense sytrd4 fallback; float/double conversion plus predicated double second-stage code is also intrinsically much slower than full FP64 accumulation.

Used FP64 products and intra-warp accumulation but rounded each of 16 warp totals to FP32 for the original inter-warp reduction and correction multiply. Register use drops to 40 per thread; build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass. Full metric is 37474.961 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even are 117225/148227/89886 us. The path remains repair-free and mixed improves versus full FP64, while dense and LAPACK-even slow slightly due a different numerical trajectory.

Computed each v*y product in FP32, converted the rounded product to double, and retained full double intra/inter-warp accumulation and correction multiplication. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass; full metric is 37480.025 us. Dense/mixed/LAPACK-even are 115830/151066/88951 us, close to true-FP64 trial 115738/150782/88944 but not faster overall. Benchmark LAPACK-even remains repair-free, showing the changed validation residual does not imply fallback at batch 640.

Templated the panel reducer into compile-time FP64-dot and FP32-dot specializations, launching the accurate 50-register kernel for the first 16 panels (start<264) and the fast 44-register kernel thereafter. Both retain 512 threads/two-CTA residency. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass. Full metric is 37458.748 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even are 115675/150347/88857 us, each slightly faster than all-panel FP64 115738/150782/88944 while remaining repair-free.

Reduced the accurate prefix from 16 to 8 panels (start<136), leaving 24 panels on the compile-time FP32 specialization. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass. Full metric regresses to 37674.039 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even are 117917/154278/91012 us. Required exact-SHA profiles show 45.06 ms dense panel time (22.66 ms across 8 FP64 panels + 22.40 ms across 24 FP32 panels), 18.93 ms solve, and zero LAPACK-even sytrd4 fallback. The runtime loss is panel arithmetic/trajectory rather than repair.

Raised the compile-time accurate prefix from 8 to 12 panels (start<200), leaving 20 FP32 panels. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass. Full metric is 37493.835 us; dense improves to 115607 us versus 117917 with 8 accurate panels, while mixed/LAPACK-even are 151365/89634 us versus 154278/91012. All remain repair-free; workload-dependent numerical trajectories keep the 16-panel split faster on mixed/LAPACK-even.

Raised the accurate prefix to 14 panels (start<232), leaving 18 FP32 panels. Build, kernelguard, and all 39 tests pass. Full metric is 37440.290 us; dense/mixed/LAPACK-even are 115924/150748/89012 us. This improves over 12 accurate panels but is component-wise slower than 16 accurate panels at 115675/150347/88857; the precision-split threshold is now bracketed.
Split n512 eigenvalue bisection and inverse iteration across 128 active threads, using the dead reduced matrix as coalesced factor workspace; restore the component-best 16 accurate panels
Double split-solver tile width to 256 eigenpairs, halving solve CTAs per matrix while keeping one active thread per eigenpair
Use one 512-thread CTA per n512 matrix for both bisection and inverse iteration, eliminating duplicated tridiagonal loads across solve tiles
Reduce n512 inverse iteration from two passes to one with 256-thread solve tiles; validation passes but certification routes dense matrices through expensive repair
Restore two inverse iterations and reduce n512 bisection from 25 to 24 rounds; reduced eigenvalue precision increases dense and mixed certification repairs
Increase n512 bisection from 24 to 26 rounds with two inverse iterations; extra precision does not eliminate repair and regresses dense random timing
Fuse 25-round n512 eigenvalue bisection and two-pass inverse iteration into 256-thread CTAs, reusing tridiagonal shared memory and eliminating the intermediate values launch boundary
Use FP64 correction scalars in all 32 n512 panels with the fused solve; slightly worsens every n512 benchmark despite unrelated aggregate-score noise
Restore the best 16-panel FP64 threshold and use __fdividef only in the fused n512 Sturm recurrence; validation residuals remain identical while dense timing improves
Use __fdividef in the n512 Thomas forward and backward solves in addition to the Sturm recurrence; residuals remain stable but every n512 benchmark regresses
Restore precise Thomas division and halve fused n512 tile width to 128 eigenpairs; duplicated loads and reductions outweigh any occupancy benefit
Restore 256-thread fused tiles and remove the unused n512 status tensor and stores; measured execution regresses despite less plumbing
Restore the exact trial-41 champion tree after geometry and cleanup sweeps; clean rebuild and all 39 validation cases pass, repeat metric remains within suite variance

Selected final commit 535994131e54d9a0a1e322905d7f64fce6b268af (tree-identical to best-scoring e19bc1b13df2acfad0c64f2df4ad1af3400f6bd5): fuse n512 25-round bisection and two-pass inverse iteration into 256-thread CTAs, reuse the reduced matrix as coalesced factor workspace, retain 16 accurate panels, and use fast division only in Sturm counting. Best observed full metric 36283.745576; final repeat 36339.536327 versus brief parent 37581.232. Clean build and all 39 validation cases pass. Final exact-SHA profile shows fused solve 3.734 ms versus prior integrated solve 18.928 ms.
